title: Siegfried
summary: Swiss contract manufacturer of small-molecule drugs and drug products.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Siegfried provides contract development and manufacturing for small-molecule APIs and finished dosage forms, with plants in Switzerland, Europe and the US. It serves pharma and biotech customers and has been expanding sterile fill-finish capacity. Utilisation and new contract wins drive results.

Technology Exposure

  • Small-molecule API manufacturing
  • Finished dosage forms
  • Sterile fill-finish

What To Watch

  • Plant utilisation
  • New contract wins
  • Energy and raw-material costs

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
